comment: UI actions the smart navigator can pick (`action:<id>`): what each does, in the words a request is matched against. The UI registers one handler per id (ui/src/navigation/ui-actions.ts); a test holds the two to the same ids.

actions.history-back: Go back to the previous screen (browser back)
actions.bookmarks-menu: Open the bookmarks menu: my saved favorites
actions.open-in-window: Pop the current tab out into a new window
actions.theme-toggle: Switch between dark mode and light mode
actions.new-chat-default-harness: Start a new chat (a new session with the default agent)
actions.new-chat-claude-code: Start a new Claude Code chat / session
actions.new-chat-codex: Start a new Codex chat / session
actions.new-chat-copilot: Start a new Copilot chat / session
actions.new-chat-opencode: Start a new OpenCode chat / session
actions.fork-session: Fork the current session into a new one
actions.project-list: Switch project: open the project picker
actions.open-folder: Open a folder as a project
actions.new-project-from-git: Clone a git repository / open a project from git
actions.invite-members: Invite someone (a member) to this project
actions.git-checks-dialog: Set up git for this project
actions.add-dependency: Add a dependency to this project
actions.quick-create-agent: Create a new agent (an empty one, to fill in; a request that also says what it should contain goes to the assistant)
actions.quick-create-skill: Create a new skill (an empty one, to fill in; a request that also says what it should contain goes to the assistant)
actions.quick-create-subagent: Create a new sub-agent (an empty one, to fill in; a request that also says what it should contain goes to the assistant)
actions.quick-create-dynamic-workflow: Create a new workflow (an empty one, to fill in; a request that also says what it should contain goes to the assistant)
actions.quick-create-task: Create a new task (an empty one, to fill in; a request that also says what it should contain goes to the assistant)
actions.quick-create-markdown: Create a new markdown document (an empty one, to fill in; a request that also says what it should contain goes to the assistant)
actions.quick-create-whiteboard: Create a new whiteboard (an empty one, to fill in; a request that also says what it should contain goes to the assistant)
actions.quick-create-mcp: Add an MCP server (an empty one, to fill in; a request that also says what it should contain goes to the assistant)
actions.quick-create-credential: Add a credential / an API key (an empty one, to fill in; a request that also says what it should contain goes to the assistant)
actions.quick-create-modal: Open the quick create menu: create anything new
actions.new-data-source-dialog: Connect a new data source / add a feed
actions.new-endpoint-dialog-hub: Create a new LLM endpoint (on the hub)
actions.new-sandbox-hub: Create a new sandbox (on the hub)
actions.new-conversation-dialog: Start a new conversation / send a message to someone
actions.view-mode-vibe: Switch the app to vibe mode
actions.view-mode-advanced: Switch the app to terminal (advanced) mode
actions.assistant-chat: Ask the Flowpad Assistant: open its chat
actions.restart-session: Restart the current session (its Restart button)
